public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  for each step in dependencies.keys().sorted()
    let wanted be dependencies.get(step) otherwise crash with "unreachable: missing step {step}"
    for each dep in wanted
      if not dependencies.contains_key(dep) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: dep)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable placed: List of Text be []
  repeat until placed.length() is dependencies.length()
    let mutable ready: List of Text be []
    for each step in dependencies.keys().sorted()
      let wanted be dependencies.get(step) otherwise crash with "unreachable: missing step {step}"
      let blocked be for each dep in wanted any not placed.contains(dep)
      if not placed.contains(step) and not blocked then
        set ready to ready.append(step)
      end
    end
    if ready.is_empty() then
      let left be
        for each step in dependencies.keys().sorted()
        where not placed.contains(step)
        collect step
      fail with Cycle(remaining: left)
    end
    let chosen be ready.first() otherwise crash with "unreachable: no ready step"
    set placed to placed.append(chosen)
  end
  return placed
end

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  for each step in dependencies.keys() sorted by step
    let wanted be dependencies.get(step) otherwise crash with "unreachable: missing step {step}"
    for each dependency in wanted
      if not dependencies.contains_key(dependency) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: dependency)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable placed: List of Text be []
  repeat until placed.length() is dependencies.length()
    let mutable chosen: maybe Text be nothing
    for each candidate in dependencies.keys() sorted by candidate
      if chosen is nothing and not placed.contains(candidate) then
        let needed be dependencies.get(candidate) otherwise crash with "unreachable: missing step {candidate}"
        if for each need in needed all placed.contains(need) then
          set chosen to candidate
        end
      end
    end
    match chosen
      when some(next_step) then
        set placed to placed.append(next_step)
      when nothing then
        let remaining be
          for each leftover in dependencies.keys()
          where not placed.contains(leftover)
          sorted by leftover
          collect leftover
        fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
    end
  end
  return placed
end

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let names be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  for each name in names
    let wanted be dependencies.get(name) otherwise []
    for each wanted_step in wanted
      if not dependencies.contains_key(wanted_step) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: name, depends_on: wanted_step)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable done: List of Text be []
  let mutable remaining: List of Text be names
  repeat until remaining.is_empty()
    let mutable next: maybe Text be nothing
    for each step in remaining
      let deps be dependencies.get(step) otherwise []
      let blocked be for each dep in deps any not done.contains(dep)
      if not blocked then
        set next to step
        break
      end
    end
    match next
      when some(chosen) then
        set done to done.append(chosen)
        set remaining to for each other in remaining where other is not chosen collect other
      when nothing then
        fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
    end
  end
  return done
end

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let names be for each name in dependencies.keys() sorted by name collect name
  for each step in names
    let needed be dependencies.get(step) otherwise []
    for each need in needed
      if not dependencies.contains_key(need) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: need)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable placed: List of Text be []
  let mutable waiting be names
  repeat until waiting.is_empty()
    let mutable chosen: maybe Text be nothing
    for each candidate in waiting
      let needed be dependencies.get(candidate) otherwise []
      let blocked be for each need in needed any not placed.contains(need)
      if not blocked then
        set chosen to candidate
        break
      end
    end
    match chosen
      when some(picked) then
        set placed to placed.append(picked)
        set waiting to for each other in waiting where other is not picked collect other
      when nothing then
        fail with Cycle(remaining: waiting)
    end
  end
  return placed
end
